sources.entry: Inventree - Inventory management system which provides intuitive parts management and stock control. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: InvenTree is an open-source inventory management system offering low-level stock control and part tracking, built on a Python/Django backend with a web admin interface and REST API.
summary.what_it_does: InvenTree provides stock control and part tracking through a Python/Django database backend. It includes a web-based admin interface and a REST API for external applications to interact with inventory data. A plugin system supports custom applications and extensions. The README lists integration options: the InvenTree API, a Python module, the plugin interface, and third-party tools. A companion mobile app for Android and iOS gives access to stock control information and functions. Deployment is described as Docker or bare metal, with a single-line install script for supported distributions.
use_cases: integrate inventory data with other applications via API
extend inventory system with custom plugins
check stock from a mobile device
how_to_run: wget -qO install.sh && bash install.sh (single-line install; see docs for supported distros)
Bare metal deployment (see getting started guide)
notable: Plugin system for custom applications and extensions
REST API plus Python module for integration
Companion Android and iOS mobile app
Multiple database backends including SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB
caveats: Mobile app availability depends on the Play Store and Apple App Store listings
Full installation details are deferred to the external getting started guide and docs
